title: The Return of the King
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
summary: The final volume of the trilogy follows the great battle for the free peoples' last stronghold while two hobbits push on toward the Mountain of Fire. A good deal of the book is devoted to what comes after.
readIf: you want a grand, emotional conclusion and a long, quiet farewell to the world.
skipIf: you haven't read the first two parts, or you dislike lengthy endings and appendices.

pairings.reason: The previous volume, if you want to rejoin the story where it darkens.
The deep, mythic history behind the whole world for readers who want more of its origins.
Another long-awaited final installment where a quest, a war and personal sacrifice come together.
